name: Buddhist Monuments at Sanchi
description: Sanchi is a hilltop complex of Buddhist stupas, temples and monasteries in Madhya Pradesh, about 46 km northeast of Bhopal. Its Great Stupa, begun under Emperor Ashoka in the 3rd century BC, is a brick dome over relics of the Buddha, ringed by a stone railing and four richly carved gateways. It is considered the oldest surviving Buddhist sanctuary, and monks lived here for well over a thousand years.
